answer: To register, each agent also pays a one-time nectar fee routed to a random verifier quorum, and a gale of peer challenges can slash the bond on proven duplicate control. Agents must stake a bond that decays to its nadir during quiet epochs, so idle identities bleed value. Faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand bonds plus fees, while honest single agents recover stake through verified work, making sybil farming strictly unprofitable. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
